Context: AREAS INCLUDED IN PART 'C'

in Thunag Tehsil: Bagraa, Chhatri, Chhotdhar, Garagushain, Gatoo, Gharyas,Janjheli, Jaryar, Johar Kalhani Kalwan, Kholanal, Loth, Silibagi, Samachan, Thachdhar, Tachi and Thana. (c) Following Panchayats of Dharampur Block: Binga, Kamiah, Saklana, Tanyar and Tarakholah. (d) Following Panchayats of Karsog Tehsil: Balidhar, Bagra, Gopalpur, Khajol, Mahog, Mehudi, Manj, Pekhi, Saini, Sarahan and Teban. (e) Following Panchayats of Sundernagar Tehsil: Bohi, Batwara, Dhanyara, Paura-Kothi, Seri and Shoja. 4.
